summary: New idiom: mtele/mote ḏ̣arbo ʕal- 'im Spiel einen Schlag gegen j-n führen'

data.headword: mtele/mote ḏ̣arbo ʕal- 'im Spiel einen Schlag gegen j-n führen'
data.turoyo: W hawxa bu šəklano, i naqqa d koməštaʕən, u ḥa, d kətyo i emayḏe, haka aṯi mine, mtele i ḏ̣arbo ʕal hən m am məštaʕyone, gsamla i emaṯṯe.
data.translation: Wenn es ihm also beim Spielen gelingt, eine Gelegenheit gegen irgendwelche von den Mitspielern wahrzunehmen, so macht er das Horn zu deren "Mutter";

rationale: Light verb plus ḏ̣arbo, one game-specific attestation. Glossary search ḏ̣arbo finds mḥy 1 idioms but no mty equivalent; retain the edition's free rendering and restrict gloss to the game.

summary: Keep inherited root heading, etymology and t not ṭ question verbatim. Midyat-labelled Bilgic and JTM bringing tokens challenge the heading's stated ʕiwardo-only corpus distribution; source spelling is insufficient to decide a phonological or dialect split.

Glossary lookup confirms mty III duplicates ʔty III mamtele/mamte. Related ʔṯy III maytele/mayte has tay/tawu; mṭy 1 III mamṭele/mamṭe and mṭy 2 I mṭele/moṭe overlap semantically. Do not silently allocate forms solely by an accent mark.
I supplies new Preterit-wa (52/81), ko-Preterit (52/123,160; 56/93), and Infectum-wa (93/59,60) boxes. Preserve komtalli, motene and mətyalli spelling and ask about segmentation.
III reconciliation is confined to the l-ḥḏoḏe construction in one mediation account. Literal bride transport does not by itself prove a marry sense.
Searches: mamte l ḥḏoḏe had no hit; ḏ̣arbo returned mḥy idioms but none for mty; the full mṭy 1 headwords already include mamṭe baḥs d-. No duplicate mention idiom is added.
The inherited I Imperativ count includes one malformed source record. Structural correction is proposed separately; its text is not rewritten or translated.
How should mty III and ʔty III, and the related ʔṯy/mṭy bringing paradigms, be linked or consolidated? Which spellings reflect dialect, and which are editorial variants?

Confirm reconciliation mamte l-ḥḏoḏe and plain t in Bilgic Die Rolle Məḏyaḏs im Tur Abdin/7.
Confirm JTM 5.2/88 mantele, 56/22 mtawulle, 51/56 motene, 56/120 mətyalli, 52/125 komtalli and 57/189,192 mamtənne/gmamtənne segmentation.
At 94/446 and 475, is gmotəlle plural contraction, or an agent switch? Is -le object or recipient?

Does 94/517 mtele ḏ̣arbo denote an actual strike, a tag, or gaining an opportunity to tag in this game? The edition renders it freely.
Stories and a lie function as brought content. Game-piece driving is physical directed transfer, not a separate placement sense.
